title: Machine learning identifies pore-structure windows for sodium-sulfur battery carbon hosts
summary: Machine learning screened three pore-structure parameter windows from an experimental dataset of 23 carbon hosts and 1055 specific-capacity data points. Three representative carbon hosts were then synthesized. The balanced carbon host delivered an initial capacity of 1249.4 mAh g-1 and kept 784.8 mAh g-1 after 500 cycles, and the authors link pore structure to cathode-electrolyte interphase composition.
ai_technology: Machine learning screening of pore-structure parameter windows from experimental capacity data

evidence.tested: Synthesis and electrochemical testing of three carbon hosts.
evidence.unknown: Small training set of 23 hosts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML chose the pore-structure windows used to design the hosts.
